newsitem.title: USA: Alabama Power to sell $200 mln securities.
newsitem.headline: Alabama Power to sell $200 mln securities.

text.p: Alabama Power Co said Thursday it plans to sell $200 million of preferred securities of its Alabama Power Capital Trust II.
The preferred securities are to be offered to the public at $25 per security, it said. Distributions on the securities are to be payable quarterly in arrears at an annual rate of 7.6 percent.

The company said it expects that $100 million of the proceeds from the sale will be used for the full redemption of the 7.6 percent Class A preferred stock on February 17 at a price of $25 per share. The balance is to be used to repay short-term debt.
